intro: Lesson 65: Semicircles, quarter circles and compound shapes. To understand how to find the area and perimeter of semicircles, quarter circles and compound shapes with circles

model.title: A semicircle has diameter 10 cm. Find its area and perimeter.
A quarter circle has radius 6 cm. Find its area and perimeter.
A track is a 100 m by 60 m rectangle with a semicircle on each 60 m end. How far is one lap?

parts.label: Step 1
parts.text: Two semicircles: one circle of diameter 60: π × 60 = 188.49...

The perimeter of that quarter circle

(a) a semicircle of diameter 14 cm: area and perimeter (b) a window: an 80 cm wide, 100 cm tall rectangle with a semicircle on top: total area (c) a 10 cm square with a quarter circle of radius 10 cm drawn from one corner: the area outside the quarter circle

Show that the perimeter of a semicircle of radius r is r(π + 2).
questions.a: Curved edge πr plus diameter 2r: πr + 2r = r(π + 2)
